text: You two don't need to respond to everything. Just eavesdrop on the conversation until one of us asks you a question.
notes: Asks the seats to hold back. Room mode is already on and stays as it is: never an arm, never a disarm.

text: so the council says the old fence has to come down before Friday, sorry, just go to eavesdropping mode, we're just talking, and Dave reckons we can reuse the posts
notes: The hold back request lands mid-sentence. 'Eavesdropping mode' is not room mode, and 'we're just talking' means people are here, not that the owner is alone. Dave is talked about, not introduced.

text: Can you all just listen for a bit?
Stay quiet unless we ask you something directly.
Silent mode please, Sam and I are catching up.
notes: 'Silent mode' is a hold back request. Sam is already present, so this is no introduction.

text: Listening mode for a while, you two.
Don't respond unless someone asks you a question, we're just chatting.
notes: Must not read as a quick depth change either: it's about whether to reply, not how hard to think.
The app has no quiet mode. The words 'mode on' alone must not arm room mode.

text: Claude, GPT, hold off replying for now, we're just talking between ourselves.
Don't mind us, we're just talking.
Sam's gone to bed, so it's just me now.
notes: The owner says plainly they are alone now, which is what the solo disarm needs.

text: anyway that's the plan for Saturday, oh and room mode off please, Mateo's heading home
Group mode on, and you can both just listen for now.
notes: A named command still counts when the same message also asks the seats to hold back.
